data.gender_notes: Parwar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parwar is derived from the Arabic word 'parwarah' which means to nurture, protect or take care of. The name Parwar carries the meaning “Protector, Caretaker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Parwar usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, caretaker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Parwar signifies the divine protection and care bestowed upon believers.
data.etymology: Parwar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Caretaker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parwar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: باروار
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على تربية و تنمية و نمو
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل بارى، و هو يعني تربية و تنمية و نمو، و في بعض الأحيان يأتي بمعنى الحارس أو الحافظ، و يعتبر من الأسماء ذات المعاني الجميلة و العميقة في اللغة العربية و الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: پاروار
in_urdu.meaning: اسم معنی پرورش، بڑھانا، ترقی کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: پاروار ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پرورش کرنا، بڑھانا، یا ترقی کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ روحانی ترقی اور ذاتی بہتری کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: पारवार
in_hindi.meaning: पारवार नाम का अर्थ है पालन-पोषण करना, बढ़ाना
in_hindi.long_meaning: पारवार नाम की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी भाषाओं से हुई है। इस नाम का अर्थ है पालन-पोषण करना, बढ़ाना या विकसित करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर बच्चे की आध्यात्मिक और व्यक्तिगत विकास की कामना के साथ दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: پاروار
in_pashto.meaning: پاروار د پاللو او وده کولو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: پاروار نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د پاللو، وده کولو، او یا پرمختګ دی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمو کې د مسلمانانو لپاره مهم دی او د روحاني او معنوي ودې د څرګندلو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Parwar
in_english.long_meaning: The name Parwar originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the verb 'barā' (بارى), meaning to bring up, grow, or develop. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies spiritual growth, personal development, and upbringing. It reflects the values of nurturing and guiding individuals towards a path of righteousness and self-improvement. Historically, names like Parwar have been used across various Muslim cultures to invoke blessings and positive attributes in children.

data.cultural_impact: In some Islamic communities, the name Parwar signifies protection, nurturing and care as a parent towards their children, or a community towards its members. It may be given to a child born into a large family where they are one among many siblings, emphasizing the importance of being someone who not only takes care of themselves but also looks after others. It could also be given as a motivation to an individual to be a protector and caretaker to those in need.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islam, the prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is considered an example of unconditional love and care towards his community. Parwar could be seen as a spiritual reminder to strive to uphold these qualities in our dealings with others, emulating the example set by the Prophet. Furthermore, the name could serve as a reminder for the spiritual responsibility of an individual towards their own well-being, emphasizing the importance of self-care and nourishment. By embedding the essence of 'parwarah' into our daily actions, we can increase positive impacts not only on our own lives but on the lives of those around us.
